title: Crazy Cat Lady
description: Crazy Cat Lady — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 8 One Fish and 9 Two Fish in Vergrim's Vexation.

Quest Reward: 4250 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Crazy Cat Lady (2)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go and Collect 8 One Fish and 9 Two Fish from Mutants in Vergrim's Vexation and bring them back to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Business is good, so good in fact that I can't spare a moment to go and collect the vittles that my little lovelies need to grow up to be big and strong. Would you be a dear and go get me some cat food? There is one problem; they don't all like the same food, so I will need you to get a little something for all of them. First thing first though. My little Eekee, ChinChin, Bubby, Willfun, Jyro, Liono, Skip-Skip, Frannie, Dalia, Battle Kit, Gunthar, Lambykinn, Voooom, Mrrrr, Xia, Pomp, and Hekh will only eat One Fish and Two Fish.

You can find the One Fish and Two Fish on the Mutants in Vergrim's Vexation. Once you have collected them bring them back to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston so I can feed my preciousesss.

Turn-in:

Oh, you are such a sweetheart! Thank you so much and Eekee, ChinChin, Bubby, Willfun, Jyro, Liono, Skip-Skip, Frannie, Dalia, Battle Kit, Gunthar, Lambykinn, Voooom, Mrrrr, Xia, Pomp, and Hekh thank you too!

Objectives:

  • One Fish ×8
  • Two Fish ×9

Level range: 17–30
